items.title: Infectaron pantallas de coche por su propio canal de actualización
items.summary: Kaspersky documenta el primer malware diseñado para pantallas de coche Android. No llegó por una app rara: llegó por el canal de actualización oficial.

items.title: Car screens were infected through their own update channel
items.summary: Kaspersky documents the first malware built for Android car head units. It did not arrive through a dodgy app: it came through the unit own update channel.

items.title: Explotan un fallo de vCenter cinco días después del parche
items.summary: CVE-2026-59310 permite ejecutar código sin autenticación en VMware vCenter. Broadcom parcheó el 29 de julio y cinco días después ya había explotación. 361 víctimas en 47 países.

items.title: A vCenter flaw was exploited five days after the patch shipped
items.summary: CVE-2026-59310 allows unauthenticated code execution on VMware vCenter. Broadcom shipped the fix on 29 July; exploitation began five days later. 361 victims across 47 countries.

items.title: Adobe parchea un fallo de Magento que entrega cuentas de clientes
items.summary: CVE-2026-71362 permite colarse en la sesión de otro cliente en Adobe Commerce, sin cuenta y sin que la víctima pulse nada. CVSS 9,1, corregido en la actualización de agosto.

items.title: Adobe patches a Magento flaw that hands over customer accounts
items.summary: CVE-2026-71362 lets an attacker switch into another customer’s session on Adobe Commerce, with no account and nothing for the victim to click. CVSS 9.1, fixed in the August update.

items.title: Microsoft advierte sobre el aumento de ataques del malware ACR Stealer contra sus clientes
items.summary: Microsoft ha detectado un aumento en ataques utilizando el malware ACR Stealer para robar contraseñas y tokens. Este malware extrae datos críticos del navegador para eludir MFA. Recomendación: implementa políticas de acceso condicional y monitoreo de EDR de inmediato.

items.title: La verdadera amenaza de la IA es la confianza ciega en sus decisiones automatizadas
items.summary: El uso de agentes de IA sin supervisión humana está creando riesgos críticos de seguridad al permitir la ejecución no controlada de comandos. Esta automatización sin validación facilita brechas masivas. Recomendación: implementa procesos de aprobación humana obligatorios para acciones de alto impacto y restringe los privilegios de los sistemas de IA.

items.title: Microsoft warns of surge in ACR Stealer attacks against enterprise customers
items.summary: Microsoft has observed a surge in attacks using the ACR Stealer malware to steal browser-stored passwords, authentication tokens, and sensitive documents from its enterprise customers. The malware effectively bypasses standard defenses by targeting active sessions. To mitigate this risk, implement strict conditional access policies and mandate frequent re-authentication for all cloud resources.

items.title: The Real AI Threat Is Blind Trust — Why Autonomous Execution Without Oversight Is Dangerous
items.summary: AI models left to both interpret and execute commands eliminate critical cybersecurity oversight. When systems perform actions autonomously, they become vulnerable to adversarial prompt injection that can lead to large-scale unauthorized activity. Organizations must move away from automated execution for sensitive tasks to prevent systemic failures. To protect your environment, implement mandatory manual approval workflows for all AI-initiated actions that modify system states or data.

items.title: El ransomware Inc explota vulnerabilidades de día cero en SonicWall SMA — el acceso raíz es el riesgo clave
items.summary: Al encadenar dos vulnerabilidades, los atacantes obtienen acceso de nivel raíz en los dispositivos de acceso móvil de SonicWall. Esta explotación facilita el movimiento lateral y el despliegue de ransomware. Actualice su firmware inmediatamente para mitigar este riesgo crítico.

items.title: Paquetes npm maliciosos para Vite usan blockchain para C2 — el riesgo en la cadena de suministro
items.summary: Investigadores han detectado siete paquetes npm maliciosos que atacan el ecosistema Vite utilizando infraestructura blockchain para C2. Esta campaña, llamada ViteVenom, instala un troyano de acceso remoto en las máquinas de los desarrolladores. Revise sus dependencias de inmediato y restrinja la instalación de paquetes no autorizados.

items.title: Agencias gubernamentales sufren ataques de ransomware a diario — la resiliencia es el desafío crítico
items.summary: Los informes de inteligencia indican que las organizaciones gubernamentales son atacadas diariamente por ransomware, aprovechando su necesidad crítica de mantener servicios ininterrumpidos. Los atacantes utilizan tácticas de doble extorsión para maximizar la presión sobre las agencias. Implemente arquitecturas de confianza cero y respalde sus datos de forma inmutable y fuera de línea para protegerse contra este riesgo creciente.

items.title: Inc Ransomware Exploits SonicWall SMA Zero-Days — Full Root Access Achieved via Chaining
items.summary: When chained together, the two vulnerabilities allow threat actors to gain root-level capabilities on SonicWall's mobile access appliances. This exploitation facilitates unauthorized network access and potential ransomware deployment. Patch your appliances immediately to the latest firmware version to defend against this critical threat.

items.title: Seven Malicious Vite npm Packages Use Blockchain C2 to Deliver a RAT — Supply Chain Risks Expand
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a cluster of seven malicious npm packages targeting the Vite frontend tooling ecosystem. The campaign, dubbed ViteVenom, uses blockchain-based infrastructure to hide C2 communication and deliver a remote access trojan. This attack highlights the ongoing risk of malicious dependencies in modern software development. Audit your development dependencies for unauthorized packages immediately.

items.title: Government Agencies Falling Victim to Ransomware Daily, Warns Study — High-Stakes Public Impact
items.summary: Government organizations are increasingly targeted by ransomware operators who understand that public service disruption is unacceptable. These attackers exploit critical IT infrastructure and sensitive citizen databases to force ransom payments. Implement a zero-trust architecture and ensure you have immutable, offline, and frequently tested backups to protect against operational disruption and data extortion.

items.title: Ciberseguridad mundial: rastreo de militares, malware en macOS y ataques a defensa y retail
items.summary: Historias destacadas de la semana: agentes de IA OpenClaw explotados en WhatsApp, ataque de ransomware a la firma naval TKMS y brecha de datos en Lidl. Iran rastrea a militares mediante telemetría móvil, y un nuevo malware para macOS, CrashStealer, ha sido detectado. Se recomienda encarecidamente a las organizaciones que traten las integraciones de IA como vectores de alto riesgo y auditen rigurosamente todos los complementos de terceros para evitar la exposición de datos sensibles.

items.title: Ucrania nombra a jefe de inteligencia como ministro de Defensa interino para mejorar la estrategia
items.summary: El presidente Zelenski ha nombrado a Yevhenii Khmara, exjefe interino del SBU, como ministro de Defensa interino de Ucrania. Khmara, experto en contrainteligencia y operaciones especiales, supervisará la modernización del mando militar y la integración de inteligencia avanzada para contrarrestar las operaciones rusas. Se aconseja a los contratistas y socios estratégicos que revisen sus protocolos de seguridad en las comunicaciones y se preparen para un entorno de adquisiciones más estricto bajo su administración.

items.title: Global Cyber Roundup: Iran Tracking, macOS Malware, and Defense Sector Ransomware
items.summary: Noteworthy reports indicate Iranian state-affiliated actors are tracking U.S. military personnel via mobile telemetry, while a new macOS malware, CrashStealer, has emerged. Additionally, AI agents like OpenClaw have been exploited via WhatsApp, and defense contractor TKMS confirmed a ransomware attack. To protect your organization, treat all AI-integrated agents as high-risk components, conduct rigorous security assessments before deployment, and ensure mobile device location permissions are strictly managed to prevent sensitive data exposure.

items.title: Ukraine Appoints Intelligence Expert as Acting Defense Minister to Strengthen Strategy
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has appointed Yevhenii Khmara, formerly the acting head of the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU), as the nation's new acting defense minister. Khmara, a major general with extensive counterintelligence and unconventional warfare experience, is tasked with modernizing military command and integrating intelligence-led operations into the national defense strategy. Partners and contractors are advised to review communication security protocols and prepare for tighter oversight in defense procurement processes.

items.title: La administración Trump presenta una central de vulnerabilidades asistida por IA
items.summary: El programa Gold Eagle permitirá a la industria, los operadores de infraestructura crítica y el gobierno usar inteligencia artificial para detectar, priorizar y parchear vulnerabilidades más rápido, según sus responsables.

items.title: Cyberattack threatens utterly critical infrastructure in Japan: KFC
items.summary: The Colonel stops taking online orders and may close stores after logistics partner’s systems go down

items.title: Identity Attacks Overtake Exploits as Top Ransomware Cause
items.summary: Email attacks overtook exploits as the top ransomware root cause last year. Multifactor authentication (MFA) was deployed in 97% of credential-based attacks but failed to prevent compromise.

items.title: Trump administration unveils AI-supported clearinghouse for cyber vulnerabilities
items.summary: The Gold Eagle program will allowe industry, critical infrastructure operators and the government to use artificial intelligence to rapidly detect, prioritize and patch cybersecurity vulnerabilities, officials said.

items.title: Un ciberataque amenaza una infraestructura "absolutamente crítica" en Japón: KFC
items.summary: KFC Japón deja de aceptar pedidos online y podría cerrar locales después de que los sistemas de su partner logístico cayeran por un ciberataque. La cadena no fue atacada directamente: heredó la parada de un tercero.

items.title: Los ataques de identidad superan a los exploits como principal causa de ransomware
items.summary: El correo supera a los exploits como principal causa raíz del ransomware, según una nueva investigación. El dato incómodo: el MFA estaba desplegado en el 97% de los ataques basados en credenciales — y aun así hubo compromiso.

items.title: Progress confirms zero-day vulnerability behind ShareFile disruption — vendor issues patch to restore service
items.summary: Progress Software has confirmed that a zero-day vulnerability in its ShareFile product was the cause of recent service disruptions for customers using the Storage Zones Controller. The company has since released a fix to address the security flaw and is actively working to restore services for impacted users. While initial reports highlighted instability, the company's subsequent patch is intended to remediate the underlying exploit. If you are operating a ShareFile Storage Zones Controller environment, verify that you have applied the latest vendor-supplied patch immediately to regain service stability and mitigate potential compromise.

items.title: Progress confirma un zero-day tras la caída de ShareFile — publica un parche para restaurar el servicio
items.summary: Progress confirma que un zero-day en ShareFile causó la caída del Storage Zones Controller. Ya hay parche — aplícalo antes de restaurar el servicio.

items.title: SharePoint RCE lands on CISA's must-patch list — the bulletin came weeks after the fix
items.summary: Microsoft shipped the fix for CVE-2026-45659 in May's cumulative update but didn't publish the security bulletin until May 21 — weeks after the patch was already live. CISA has since confirmed active exploitation and added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, giving federal agencies until July 4 to patch. The flaw (CVSS 8.8) is remote code execution via unsafe deserialization of untrusted data. Running SharePoint Server on-prem? Don't assume routine Patch Tuesday cadence covers this — confirm you're specifically on the May cumulative update.

items.title: A perfect 10.0 in SimpleHelp puts MSPs back in the supply-chain blast radius
items.summary: CVE-2026-48558 scores the maximum possible CVSS severity in SimpleHelp, remote management software widely used by managed service providers; exploitation is being tracked through what researchers call the "TaskWeaver" loader. The risk isn't really about SimpleHelp in isolation — RMM-tool compromises are dangerous because one vulnerable MSP endpoint can fan out into every client network that MSP touches. If your organization outsources IT to a third party, this is a fair, direct question to put to them this week, not just an internal patch item.

items.title: JetBrains patches auth bypass and RCE across Hub, YouTrack, IntelliJ and more
items.summary: A cluster of critical flaws across JetBrains' on-prem tools — Hub, YouTrack, IntelliJ IDEA, Kotlin tooling, GoLand — chain into authentication bypass, account takeover, and remote code execution. The sharpest: a weak random number generator made Hub's account-restore codes predictable enough to enumerate (CVSS 9.8), plus a separate flaw allowing authentication bypass via direct database access. Worth remembering: an IDE runs with the same privileges as the developer using it, and plugin/project trust models are usually more permissive than people assume. Patch before opening untrusted repositories in any JetBrains product, not only the ones named here.

items.title: Un 10.0 perfecto en SimpleHelp vuelve a poner a los MSP en el radio de la cadena de suministro
items.summary: CVE-2026-48558 alcanza la severidad CVSS máxima en SimpleHelp, software RMM muy usado por MSP. La explotación se rastrea a través del cargador 'TaskWeaver'.

items.title: JetBrains parchea bypass de autenticación y RCE en Hub, YouTrack, IntelliJ y más
items.summary: Un conjunto de fallos críticos en las herramientas on-premise de JetBrains se encadena en bypass de autenticación, toma de cuentas y RCE, el más grave con CVSS 9.8.

items.title: El RCE de SharePoint entra en la lista de parcheo urgente de CISA — el boletín llegó semanas después del parche
items.summary: CVE-2026-45659: Microsoft parcheó un RCE crítico en SharePoint en mayo, pero el boletín de seguridad llegó semanas después. CISA confirma explotación activa.

items.title: Anthropic ships Claude Sonnet 5 as the new default — agentic performance near Opus, at Sonnet pricing
items.summary: Claude Sonnet 5 went live June 30, 2026 and is now the default model for Free and Pro users. Anthropic's pitch is squarely agentic: planning, tool use across browsers and terminals, and autonomous runs at a level that used to require a larger, pricier model — with safety evaluations reportedly showing a lower rate of undesirable behavior than Sonnet 4.6. Introductory pricing runs through August 31, 2026 before stepping up. Practical takeaway if you've got Claude wired into your own tooling: benchmark it against your existing eval set before switching wholesale — agentic gains on paper don't always survive contact with your specific workflows.

items.title: Anthropic lanza Claude Sonnet 5 como nuevo modelo por defecto — rendimiento agéntico cercano a Opus, al precio de Sonnet
items.summary: Claude Sonnet 5 ya es el modelo por defecto para usuarios Free y Pro desde el 30 de junio de 2026, con foco en trabajo agéntico y planificación autónoma.
